about: Ruleset versions: a name for each hash of the six rule files (pqlite/version.py RULESET_FILES). A run records ruleset_version and ruleset_sha256 in receipt.json. Each version lists sha256, since (the first tool version that shipped it), verdict_impact (yes when the same trees can get a different verdict, check status or count than under the previous ruleset; no when only comments or wording changed) and files (path and sha256 of each rule file). Changing a rule file needs a new name here, a new current, and a CHANGELOG entry with its verdict impact. A ruleset with verdict_impact yes first ships in a MINOR release (MAJOR from 1.0), never a PATCH release (tests/version_policy.py). pqlite/version.py --ruleset-json prints sha256 and files for the rule files on disk.
